title: Trump administration attributes New Jersey drones to the FAA
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Trump administration attributes New Jersey drones to the FAA, about 2024-2025 at New Jersey, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think the first uh, you know, official act that the Trump administration took in dismissing what was going on up in uh, New Jersey, for example, that this was an FAA regulated uh, set of set of events.

plain: A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell, speaking as a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about mysterious drone sightings over New Jersey around 2024 and 2025. McConnell says that one of the first official acts of the Trump administration was to dismiss the sightings by saying they were events regulated by the FAA, the US agency that oversees civilian flying, which in his framing was a way of brushing them aside.
